faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NCA - F Teaching Associates Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to receive the application for the NCA - F Teaching Associates Recruitment 2026 is 01 October 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Teaching Associates post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduation or above Degree in a relevant discipline such as Physiology or Management, with a first division or equivalent grade. An aptitude for academics and research is also necessary.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Teaching Associates position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Teaching Associates post is 40 years. There is no minimum age limit specified in the provided data.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Teaching Associates role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Teaching Associates position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 60,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Teaching Associates post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Teaching Associates post in the National Communications Academy - Finance.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the NCA - F Teaching Associates Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Teaching Associates post will involve a Written Test followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. In which mode should the application be submitted?
faq.answer: Applications for the NCA - F Teaching Associates Recruitment 2026 must be submitted in offline mode, likely through post, as indicated by the application mode.

faq.question: Q9. Does the NCA - F provide any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The provided data does not explicitly mention age relaxation for reserved categories. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification for detailed information on age relaxation policies.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of the National Communications Academy - Finance, which is www.nicf.gov.in.
